scope: XcodeProjectDefinitionCore materializes a Pkl-owned application project outside its source root, retaining source-root-relative package paths, target xcconfig projection, and generated application Info.plist behavior.
commands: xcrun xcodebuild -project <generated-project> -scheme <scheme> -configuration Dogfood -sdk macosx CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
toolingBoundary: The first two commands establish source and standalone-package behavior. The xcodebuild commands establish generated-project configuration and unsigned build behavior. None of these commands proves an installed Vaporize runtime, consumer migration, release, publication, or human approval.
claims: Typed project paths resolve from the Pkl source root when the generated project is external to that root.
Declared target xcconfig files remain Xcode base-configuration references.
An application with no explicit Info.plist requests generated Info.plist behavior.
